name: statT-smoke
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels temperature --means-cache {out}/static_means.npy -- scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels temperature --means-cache {out}/static_means.npy -- research/exp/cache.py --out {out}/cache_sel; {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels temperature --means-cache {out}/static_means.npy -- research/exp/epoch_variant.py --run {out} --overlay research/overlays/desk_tempho_1985_yw_smoke.json --cache-out {out}/cache_late --work {out}/late; ls {out}/cache_sel {out}/cache_late | head
note: E038 wrapper smoke: 3-epoch DESK, selected + late caches, all under static temperature
